experiment: First 32-case job of four-bit adder operand sweep; a=0..1, b=0..15, carry-in=0
source: actual native end-of-tick trace, analyzed offline
tick_origin: recorder start; all sample ticks relative

encoding.selected_fields: ordered five output blocks: id and properties.lit; no coordinates or identities
encoding.delta_schema: same relative tick plus DeltaCache.sample("blocks",value), including initial snapshot
encoding.measurement: sum of UTF-8 JSON.stringify bytes, no whitespace or newline framing

limits: Only the initial baseline and actual change entries are encoded; unchanged ticks are not invented as full observations.
Both paths encode the same sampled selected states; cadence is change-driven, not fixed-rate polling.
One initial full baseline is included; this trace had no gaps and required no resynchronization.
Measurements are local JSON encodings, not live traffic, model tokens, billing or total assistant context.
Only five output lamps are represented; this does not claim the same reduction for every internal circuit signal.
